title: JSON Viewer
intro: Open a large JSON file to browse it without loading it into memory.

search.title: Search
search.truncated: Showing the first {count} results; refine the search to see others.

actions.title: Selected node
actions.none: Select a node in the tree or a search result.
actions.previewCut: Preview cut at {count} characters; copy or save to get everything.
actions.valueCut: The value is larger than the copy limit ({max}); save it to a file instead.
